descriptionChirho: The proper noun designating Sanballat the Horonite, the Samaritan governor who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls (Neh 2:10, 19; 4:1, 7; 6:1-14; 13:28). All 10 occurrences refer to the same individual, differing only in prepositional framing (bare noun, with waw conjunctive, with lamed 'to/of'). Multilingual evidence is uniform: eng 'Sanballat / of Sanballat', spa 'Sanbalat / de Sanbalat', arb 'سَنْبَلَطُ / لِسَنْبَلَّطَ', kor '산발랏이 / 에 산발랏', swa 'Sanbalati / wa Sanbalati'. No semantic distinction exists between the clusters.
